text_markup: Effects that instruct a player to look at, reveal, expose, or access a card are not the same, even if they would be performed similarly at times. See {ref:chpt_access_breach} for more information on accessing.
text_plain: Effects that instruct a player to look at, reveal, expose, or access a card are not the same, even if they would be performed similarly at times. See section 7 for more information on accessing.
